name: White Rabbit

revision.note: Rewritten from the human-performer reading to a photoreal CGI animal.

rendering.species: domestic rabbit (Oryctolagus cuniculus), albino white, small compact build
rendering.limits: Rabbit anatomy throughout (leporine skull, split upper lip, long ears, hind-leg-driven gait). No cartoon face, no human hands, no human in costume. Dialogue carried by naturalistic mouth, nose and whisker movement.

gender_note.quote: he came trotting along in a great hurry, muttering to himself

base_age_note.reason: Persona age (anxious senior household functionary and court herald), kept for voice casting. As an animal he is a fully mature adult rabbit: slightly coarser guard hair at the cheeks, no kitten softness.

hair.color: pure snow white all over, no markings
hair.style: dense, soft, short body fur lying smooth; finer and fluffier at the cheeks and chest ruff; long white whiskers
hair.quote: a White Rabbit with pink eyes / Oh my ears and whiskers, how late it’s getting! / Oh my fur and whiskers!

eyes.shape: large, round, set on the sides of the head; blinks and widens when anxious
eyes.quote: a White Rabbit with pink eyes
eyes.echo: Same colouring as the real waking-frame rabbit CRE-001, so the dream figure reads as that rabbit.

skin.tone: pink skin showing through at the nose leather, the inner ears and the eyelid rims

face.shape: rabbit head: short rounded muzzle, split upper lip, long upright ears that flatten back when he is frightened
features: whiskers that flick with every nervous sniff
front incisors just visible when he speaks
face.default_expression: flustered and hurried; at court a nervous, eager ear-forward attentiveness; flattened ears and a stiff crouch when the Queen is near
face.expressiveness: kept inside real rabbit behaviour: ear angle, nose rate, eye widening, body crouch. No human smile or eyebrow.
face.quote: talking in a hurried nervous manner, smiling at everything that was said / frowning and making faces at him as he spoke
face.reason: Manner is sourced; the 'smiling' and 'making faces' are translated into rabbit ear, nose and lip movement.

build.height_note: Sitting-up height, head top without ears; ears add about 8 cm. Body length nose-to-tail about 32-36 cm.
build.posture: Runs on all fours at speed. Sits up and rears on his hind legs to stand, look at the watch and carry things; carrying the gloves and fan he takes short upright hops on his hind legs (the one dream licence in his movement).
build.scale_reference: At Alice's true size (135 cm, CHAR-alice anchor) he runs past below her knee (ch001). In the garden (ch008) Alice is about a foot high, and he rises on tiptoe to put his mouth to her ear: at that beat his reared height is just below her ear. In his house giant Alice is 'about a thousand times as large' (ch004-p13). All Alice size beats stay SUP-003.
build.quote: then raised himself upon tiptoe, put his mouth close to her ear
build.reason: A small breed is chosen so the sourced tiptoe-to-ear beat works against a foot-high Alice at natural rabbit size.

marks.description: a small fitted 1862 waistcoat (buff-and-brown check) cut to the rabbit's body, with a watch pocket; the only garment he wears
marks.quote: took a watch out of its waistcoat-pocket

marks.description: large gold pocket-watch on a chain, pulled out and held in both forepaws to check
a pair of white kid gloves and a large fan (dropped in the hall), scaled to him
small round wire spectacles, put on to read
marks.note: Plain lenses; the old pink tint is dropped because his own eyes are now pink.

marks.description: a small herald's trumpet and a parchment scroll

default_outfit_tone.summary: Bare white rabbit wearing only the small checked waistcoat with the gold watch chain; at the trial a small crimson herald's tabard with a white-piped heart badge is added over the waistcoat.
default_outfit_tone.quote: splendidly dressed / took a watch out of its waistcoat-pocket
default_outfit_tone.reason: Waistcoat and 'splendidly dressed' are sourced; per SUP-002 (BIB-0027) he wears only the text's props, so the frock coat, trousers and collar of the old card are dropped. Colours designed; tabard follows FAC-house-of-hearts livery. Garment cut and pattern belong to 06-art/costume.

sound_tic: a light sniff or nose-flutter under his hurried speech (SUP-002 sound_signature)
prompt_base_en: photoreal small albino white rabbit, pure snow-white fur, pink-red eyes, pink nose and inner ears, long white whiskers, sitting up on its hind legs, wearing only a small fitted buff-and-brown checked waistcoat with a gold watch chain, holding a large gold pocket watch in its forepaws, anxious twitching nose, natural rabbit anatomy, live-action film plate, realistic lighting
